text:
ana (People Ops): Hi team — quick sync on Li's UK sponsorship transfer. Start date is listed as June 15 in the offer, but Li's current sponsor needs to release. Any updates?
mike (Recruiter): Hiring manager wants to keep 6/15 if possible. Current sponsor said they can issue the release by end of next week but we need to prepare CoS asap.
sarah (Hiring Manager): Can Li start remotely if visa delays? We can do onboarding tasks but not customer-facing work.
li (New Hire): I can start remotely for docs/training, yes. My last working day with current employer is June 7. Will need guidance on passport/BRP uploads.
ana (typo correction) — ignore
ana? (oops)
ana? ignore
visa-bot: Automated reminder: For Skilled Worker transfers, request Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS) at least 10 working days before planned visa application. See: https://docs.redwood.com/immigration/uk-sponsorship
ana? stop
ana (People Ops): corrected thread — sorry for the noise.
ana (People Ops): Ok action list: 1) James/Legal to approve CoS text 2) Mike to confirm salary band and role code 3) Li to submit passport scan + proof of employment 4) People Ops to raise CoS request in sponsor portal.
james (Legal): Can confirm CoS wording. Need final proposed start date and salary baseline. Also confirm there are no embargoes from current sponsor (Li said they'd release).
mike (Recruiter): Confirmed salary band = Senior SWE L2, code RQ-ENG-02. Start date tentative 2026-06-15. I'll ask Li for written confirmation of release timeline.
li (New Hire): Attaching passport scan now (uploaded to secure folder). I also booked biometric appointment for June 9 in Manchester.
ana? omg
ana stop this test (chatty)
ana silence
ana hush
ana sorry ignore
ana stop (this won't appear)
ana again ignore
ana stop.
ana: omg sorry again — Slack lagged, ignore prior junk messages.
ana (People Ops): Proceeding — Mike, please send the final CoS request form. Template below for subject line: `REQUEST CoS - Li Zhao - Senior SWE - RQ-ENG-02`
ana: also ignore my repeated typos, promise done.
visa-bot: Priority service available for visa applications (extra fee). Typical decision time: 5-10 working days with priority; standard ~15-21.
ana (People Ops): If Li's biometric is 6/9, we should aim to have CoS assigned by 6/1 to give buffer. Can Legal sign off by EOD 5/28?
james (Legal): Yes, I can review and sign by 5/28 EOD. Please put draft CoS text in #private-legal channel and cc me.
mike (Recruiter): Drafting CoS request now. Will include job summary + salary + pro-rated start date note.
li (New Hire): One Q — do I need to bring BRP to first day if it's issued after start?
james (Legal): BRP only if you have it. If visa decision pending, we can onboard for internal tasks only. No customer work until right-to-work check passes. People Ops will do pre-employment checks.
ana (People Ops): Note for payroll: once visa is granted we need proof to set tax code. Mike — please flag payroll once Li confirms visa grant.
mike (Recruiter): Will do. Also confirming relocation package start date alignment.
li (New Hire): Thanks — I appreciate the contingency options.
ana (People Ops): Final: I'll open the sponsor portal ticket after Mike posts the CoS draft. Adding checklist link: https://docs.redwood.com/internal/peopleops/immigration-checklist (upload passport, signed offer, last payslip, employer release statement, biometric appt confirmation).
visa-bot: Ticket created in sponsor portal: #SPONSOR-5218 — awaiting assignment.
mike (Recruiter): CoS draft posted to #private-legal, tagged @james.
james (Legal): Reviewed and ok, approved. Go ahead People Ops.
ana (People Ops): Raised CoS request — portal shows pending allocation, ETA 3 working days. I will update thread when CoS assigned. :thumbsup:
li (New Hire): Thanks all! Will keep biometric appointment notes here.
ana (People Ops): Closing loop — if CoS delays beyond 6/3 we should shift start target to 6/29. Will update.
mike (Recruiter): Noted. Keeping hiring manager in the loop.
li (New Hire): Understood. Appreciate the team's help :pray:
